Nina tamaa kubwa ya kukukutana nawe, nikikumbuka machozi yako, ili niweze kujazwa kwa furaha; Ninapokumbuka imani isiyo ya uongo iliyokuwepo ndani yako, ambayo kwanza ilikaa katika babu yako Loisi, na katika mama yako Eunisi; na ninaamini kwamba pia iko ndani yako. Kwa hiyo nakukumbusha utunze kipawa cha Mungu kilichomo ndani yako kwa kumsimamisha mikono yangu juu yako. Kwa maana Mungu hatutolei roho ya woga; bali ya nguvu, na ya upendo, na ya akili timamu – 2 Timotheo 1:4-7.

“Ee Mungu, utupatie mama kama Eunisi na babu kama Loisi. Utupatie wanawake wa imani. Utupatie wanawake wanaojua kusimama kwa ajili ya ukweli dhidi ya mawimbi ya utafiti wa kibinadamu yanayoharibu maisha ya watu wengi wenye nia njema. Utupatie wanawake wasiyoegemea katika uaminifu wao kwa Yesu Kristo, kwa wake zao, na kwa wito wao wa kuwakilisha roho ya Yesu katika maisha yote. Amina”.

Historia imethibitisha kwamba wanawake wanachangia kwa nguvu sawa na wanaume katika kuunda muundo wa jamii na wa jamii ya Wakristo. Inaweza semekana kuwa wanatoa ushawishi mkubwa zaidi ukizingatia kuwa wana jukumu kubwa katika kuunda maadili ya watoto wachanga na, iwe wanavaa na kujitendea kwa unyenyekevu wa kiungu au la, wanaweza kuathiri maadili ya umati wa wanaume waliowazunguka.

Hivyo basi wito kwa wanawake kuwa wanawake wa imani. Imani ya mwanamke haikuathiri tu watu waliomzunguka, bali kila mwanamke ana safari yake ya kibinafsi. Safari yake ni kutafuta utambulisho, usalama, na kusudi la maisha yake.

Wanawake wa leo wanazidiwa kwa sauti nyingi zinazodai kutoa utimizaji unaotakiwa na moyo wao. Kama kwa mama yao Hawa, sauti nyingi hizi zinavuta roho yao ya kike, lakini kama mama yao Hawa alivyogundua, isipokuwa ni sauti ya Mungu, inasababisha mauti na uharibifu.

Biblia imejaa rekodi za wanawake waliouishi kwa imani. Fikiria juu ya mke haramu Rahabu. Watafiti wa Biblia hawawezi kukubaliana kabisa kwamba alistahili hadhi hiyo, lakini jina hilo limepitishwa kwetu hivyo. Alisikia hadithi za Mungu wa Israeli. Alipokutana na waangalizi na kusikia utabiri wao wa kuogofya kuhusu mji wake alichagua kuamini.

Alikuwa mzaliwa wa Yerikho. Yerikho ilikuwa nyumbani kwake. Yerikho ilikuwa na kuta za jiwe kubwa na walinzi jasiri. Angekuwa na sababu nyingi za kuweka imani yake kwa yale aliyoyafahamu na yaliomfikisha katika wakati uliopita.

Alichagua kuweka imani yake kwa Mungu wa Israeli. Wanaume wa Israeli walimwambia kwamba kama angeweka uzi mwekundu dirishani kwake juu ya ukuta, nyumba yake na maisha yake yangebaki salama. Uzi mwekundu. Si kitu kikubwa kwa ajili ya utambulisho au usalama, lakini Rahabu aliweka imani yake kwenye uzi mwekundu. Uzi huo mwekundu ulieleza nguvu ya Mungu wa Israeli na, kama tunavyojua leo, ni mfano mzuri wa damu ya Yesu.

Wito wa kuwa mwanamke wa imani ni wito wa kugeukia mbali itikadi ya dunia na kukumbatia kile ambacho kwa macho ya dunia ni tiba isiyo na maana—uzi mwekundu. Imani ya Rahabu ilitokana na ujuzi wake wa Mungu wa Israeli na mpango Wake wa kuhukumu watu wake. Uzi mwekundu ulikuwa tumaini lake la ukombozi.

Ningependa tufikirie jinsi imani kwa Mungu inavyoathiri tamaa kuu za moyo wa kike. Kila mwanamke anamtamania utambulisho, usalama, na kusudi. Yesu amekuja kukutana na tamaa hiyo ya moyo.

Utambulisho – “Mimi ni nani?”

Hili ni swali ambalo kila mtu anakuzwa kujiuliza kwa wakati fulani wa maisha—mara nyingi ujana. Vijana wa kiume hujenga utambulisho wao kwa msingi wa wanayowaheshimu na mwelekeo wao wa kazi. Vijana wa kike, hasa katika jamii zetu za Anabaptisti, kwa kiasi kikubwa wako mwembamba mbele ya wanaume maarufu katika maisha yao kuufafanua utambulisho wao.

Hii sio tu kitamaduni. Wakati Mungu alisema kwa Hawa, …tamaa yako itakuwa kwa mumeo, naye atakutawaliwa – Mwanzo 3:16, Alikuwa anatangaza kwamba yeye na uzao wake wa kike wangemwangalia mwanamume kumfafanulia sehemu muhimu ya asili yao.

Babá wana sehemu muhimu katika maendeleo ya mapema ya utambulisho wa msichana mdogo. Baba wakatili, baba wasioko, na baba wasiojali huacha msichana mdogo asiye na uhakika wa yeye ni nani, au thamani yake kama mtu. Baba anayeidhinisha uanamitindo wa mkewe anayemcha Mungu anamfunulia zawadi isiyoweza kupimika. Kwa hiyo, ninamaanisha kumpongeza kwa sifa za utu wa kike, kumbariki kwa jitihada za kuwa mchi na mwenye unyenyekevu, na ndiyo, kumwambia kwamba yeye ni mrembo.

Moyo wa mwanamke hatimaye utakgeuka kuelekea kwa mume. Mungu alisema, “Tamaa yako itakuwa kwa mumeo”, si kwa baba yako. Wanawake wengi wanaoa wakidhani kwamba hatimaye wamepata “mkombozi” wao na kwa msingi huo wako sahihi. Je, Paolo hakusema katika Waefeso sura tano kwamba mume ni “mkombozi wa mwili”? Je, mke asitarajia kupokea kutoka kwa mume wake upendo, uthibitisho, ulinzi, na malezi? Hayo ni haki yake kwa amri ya kimungu. Mume mtakatifu atafanya kila awezalo kutoa hayo kwa njia hiyo.

“Tamaa yako itakuwa kwa mumeo” imetolewa katika muktadha wa kuanguka. Ilikuwa mojawapo ya matokeo ya kuanguka. Ni kauli isiyo na ahadi ya kutimizwa. Hii inatuacha tukiamini kuwa, ingawa inachochewa na tamaa, tamaa hiyo inaweza kukosa kutimizwa.

Nini mwanamke afanye ikiwa mumewake hataki au hawezi kuridhisha tamaa ya moyo wake? Je, mwanamke hana mume? Lazima awe mwanamke wa imani. Hadi mwanamke apate utambulisho wake katika Yesu, hakuna mwanaume atakayemudu kuridhisha tamaa za ndani kabisa za moyo wake.

Ndoa nyingi zinateseka kwa sababu mke anatarajia mume wake akidhi tamaa za ndani kabisa za moyo wake ambazo ni Yesu pekee anayezitudisha. Wanaume wengi wanahisi kutokuwa na uwezo na kujibakisha wanapoatarajiwa kufanya, na kutenda, kwa wake zao kile ambacho ni Yesu pekee anayezikamilisha.

Wito kwa wanawake wote kuwa wanawake wa imani

Wanawake wa imani ni wanawake wanaojua ni nani wao katika Kristo Yesu. Wamepata tamaa za ndani kabisa za moyo wao zimekutana ndani Yake. Kwa sababu tamaa zao za moyo zimekamilika, wamegeuka kuwa chemchemi ya uzima kwa mume wao, kwa watoto wao, na kwa wengine.

Usalama – “Nani ataniulinda?”

Kuwa mwanamke imekuwa hatari kila wakati. Wanawake ni dhaifu sana. Mbali na ukweli kwamba kwa kimwili ni nyepesi zaidi, wanawake wanaweza kurahisika kubadilika kihisia, na naamini kutokana na kile Biblia inachosema kuhusu udanganyifu wa Hawa, kwamba wanawake huwa rahisi zaidi kwa udanganyifu wa kiroho (ona 1 Timotheo 2:14).

Hii haisi kuwaoza wa wanaume. Unyeti wao wa kihisia huwafanya wawe wa kuzingatia zaidi ukweli wa matatizo ya mahusiano kuliko wanaume wengi. Katika hili, maarifa yao yanaweza kuwa jambo jema, kusaidia kutulishana sisi wanaume katika baadhi ya udhaifu wetu wa asili. Iwe tunafanya kulinganisha gani, nadhani tunaweza kukubali kwamba wanawake wanahitaji ulinzi ambao wanaume hutoa.

Kama mwanaume anayepaswa kukulinda ni mwoga, je? Tuna mfano wa hali kama hiyo katika Biblia. Jina la mwanaume ni Abrahamu—ndiyo… baba wa imani. Hata wanaume wenye nguvu hupata kufanya maamuzi ya kukosa ujasiri.

Abrahamu na Sara walikuwa wakisafiri kwenda Misri. Walipokaribia Misri, Abrahamu alihofia maisha yake. Mke wake Sara alikuwa mwanamke mrembo na Abrahamu alijua kwamba Misri ilikuwa taifa la waabudu wa sanamu lenye maadili iliyokuwa laini sana. Alihofia kwamba Waegipita wangemuua ili wapate mkewe. Abrahamu alisema kwa Sara, Tamwani, sema, wewe ni dada yangu: ili niwe na heri kwa ajili yako; na nafsi yangu itaishi kwa ajili yako – Mwanzo 12:13.

Sara kwa kweli alikuwa nusu-dada wa Abrahamu. Walikuwa na baba mmoja, lakini si mama mmoja. Mpango wa dharura wa Abrahamu umaacha Sara katika nafasi ngumu sana. Hatutasoma chochote kuhusu jinsi Sara alivyoreact kwa mpango wa Abrahamu. Jambo pekee tunalojua ni kwamba …Sara alimtii Abrahamu, akimwita bwana: ambao ndio miongoni mwa nyinyi, kama mpendezavyo, msiogopi kwa hofu yoyote – 1 Petro 3:6.

Inaonekana kwamba Sara hakuwa na hofu. Imani yake haitegemei ulinzi wa Abrahamu. Alikuwa anategemea nguvu ya juu zaidi. Imani ya Sara ilimpa nafasi katika chumba cha waamini katika Waebrania sura 11 na kumfanya awe mfano wa Petro wa jinsi wake wanavyopaswa kuhusiana na waume zao.

Muhimu wa hadithi hii uko katika matokeo. Kwa sababu ya imani ya Sara, alitulizwa kutoka kwa mkono wa Farao, mfalme mwenye mamlaka mkubwa wa wakati wake. Ilikuwa imani ya Sara, si ya Abrahamu, ilimlinda.

Wanawake hawaitazami wanaume kwa ajili ya usalama, na ni sawa kuwa hivyo. Wanaume hulinda wake zao kwa kadri ya uwezo wao. Ninaamini kwamba wakati wanaume na wanawake wanaishi ndani ya nafasi walizotengwa na Mungu, kuna ulinzi mwingi na usalama unaopatikana; hata hivyo, tunaishi katika ulimwengu ulioporomoka. Hatutumii nyanja zetu kwa heshima kila wakati na wakati mwingine Mungu huruhusu uovu kutokea hata kwa mtaabika zaidi.

Wito kwa wanawake wote kuwa wanawake wa imani kama Sara

Je, una imani ya kuamini kwamba Mungu ni mkubwa zaidi kuliko mumeo au baba yako? Je, uko tayari kumtumainisha Mungu ashinde mahali ambapo mumeo anaweza kuwa dhaifu au hata makafiri dhidi ya Mungu au kanisa?

Mwanamke wa imani ni mwanamke anayechagua kumtumaini Mungu kwa kutokuwepo kwa njia ya busara mbele. Mwanamke wa imani anaendelea kufanya haki, ingawa inaweza isiwe njia ya usalama iliyohakikishwa kwa sababu …Bwana ni msaidizi wangu, sitokuwa na hofu ya mtu atakayenifanyia nini – Waebrania 13:6.

Kusudi – “Kwa nini niko hapa?”

Hili ni swali ambalo kila mtu huliuliza kwa wakati fulani wa maisha. Tunataka maisha yetu yawe na maana na kusudi. Upotevu wa kuishi bila maana unasukuma wanaume na wanawake katika msongo wa mawazo na kukata tamaa. Kuishi kwa kusudi kunatutunza na wengine na kuleta utukufu kwa Muumba wetu.

Wanaume wanapofikiri kuishi kwa kusudi, wanaiona… vita ya kupigana, mlima wa kushinda, lengo la heshima la kutamani kufikiwa. Sisi wanaume kwa kawaida tunazingatia maono na malengo.

Je, inamaanisha nini kwa mwanamke kuishi kwa kusudi?

Luka anatupatia mwanga kuhusu hili katika hadithi ya ziara ya Yesu katika nyumba ya Mariamu na Martha. (Ona Luka 10:38-42) Yesu mara nyingi alitembelea nyumba hii alipopita Bethania. Hapa alijua angepata ukarimu mkubwa na mazungumzo ya kuvutia. Leo haikuwa tukio la kipekee.

Anaporidhika katika chumba chao cha kukaa, Mariamu aliketi miguuni mwake auliza maswali na kusikiliza kwa makini alipomfunulia kusudi la maisha yake na hatima yake ya baadaye. Mariamu alifika kuelewa mambo kuhusu Yesu ambayo hata wanafunzi wake hawakuweza kuyafahamu.

Matiayo anarekodi kwamba Yesu alipokuwa akila katika nyumba ya Simone mwanamume, mwanamke, aliyedhaniwa kuwa Mariamu wa Bethania, aliingia, akainama na kumwagia miguu ya Yesu mafuta ya thamani. Wanafunzi walipokosoa kuhusu “hasa hii ya upotevu” Yesu akawaambia: Kwa maana alipotaka kumwacha huyo, alinifanya tayari kwa maziko yangu – Mathayo 26:12.

Je, Mariamu alipata uelewa huo wapi? Je, si alipokuwa “akiketi miguuni mwa Yesu?”

Martha kwa upande mwingine alikuwa “amechokea mno kuhudumia”. Sasa Yesu alihitaji kula. Mtu alihitaji kuandaa chakula na nina hakika kwamba Yesu alifurahia maandalizi ya ladha ya Martha. Lakini Yesu alimkosoa kwa “Martha, Martha”. Tazama toni ya kifamilia ya sauti yake.

Hakumhukumu wala kumhukumu kwa adhabu. Alimshinikiza achukue muda kwa mambo muhimu ya maisha. Alimpongeza Mariamu kwa kuwa …amechagua sehemu ile nzuri, ambayo haitatwaliwa kutoka kwake – Luka 10:42.

Ningependa kupendekeza kwamba wengi wa wasiwasi wetu ni matokeo ya tunayojiwekea sisi wenyewe. Tunapanga malengo kwa maisha yetu ambayo Yesu hakuwahi kuyaamuru. Tunaweka matarajio juu yetu ambayo hayana thamani ya milele. Kama Martha, tunasumbuka kwa vitu visivyo na maana, na kuharibu mahusiano kwa mambo madogo. Ndiyo, chakula cha jioni kinapaswa kutolewa, na Mariamu anapaswa kusaidia, lakini si kusahau “sehemu bora”.

Wito kwa wanawake wote kuwa wanawake wa imani kama Mariamu aliyependa kukaa miguuni mwa Yesu

Maisha kwa mke na mama yamejaa mahitaji yanayolazimisha. Punguza msongo wa maisha yako na wasiwasi kwa kutumia muda kusikiliza sauti ya Yesu—“sauti ile ndogo tulivu” aliyomsikia Eliya hatimaye.

Msongo na wasiwasi vitameng'enyuka mbele ya Yesu. Mungu anazungumza nasi kwa Roho Wake Mtakatifu kupitia Neno Lake. Ikiwa ni changamoto kwako kupata muda wa kukaa na Biblia yako, basi unaweza kutuliza roho yako ukiwa na mikono yako kwenye maji ya kuoshea vyombo, au unapofungua nguo, au unapoirudia tena kuandaa chakula kwa familia yako. Katika nyakati kama hizi unaweza kuwasiliana na Mungu. Unaweza kumuomba Baba yako aliyeko mbinguni. Unaweza kusema vitu kama “Nakupenda Ee Bwana Yesu, niene Neno Lako, lete amani kwa nafsi yangu; tuliza migogoro ya mawazo yangu; nisaidie nifikie mapumziko Yako; nizungushe kwa amani Yako.” Kisha unaweza kusikiliza Roho Yake akimuonya roho yako kwa vipande vya ukweli kutoka Maandiko yaliyofichwa ndani ya moyo wako.

Muhtasari – Wito kwa wanawake wote kuwa wanawake wa imani

Kwa ustawi wako binafsi:

Wanawake wa leo wanazidiwa na rasilimali za kujisaidia kwa njia ya vitabu, podikasti, mitandao ya kijamii, na semina. Mengi yake ni mazuri na yanaweza kusaidia, lakini hakuna kitakachemaliza uhusiano wa kibinafsi na matembezi ya kila siku na Yesu.

Kwa ustawi wa watoto wako:

Leo, zaidi kuliko hapo awali tunahitaji mama wawe wanawake wa imani ambao wanaweza kuwapeleka watoto wao kwamba kutembea na Mungu ni halisi na kuridhisha. Timotheo mchanga aliathiriwa na imani isiyo ya bandia ya mama yake na ya babu yake. Usikosema athari ya ushawishi wa maisha yako kwa maisha ya wale wanaokuja baada yako.

Kwa nguvu za mumeo:

Wanaume wa leo wanahitaji msaada wa wanawake waaminifu, hasa wake zao. Matembezi ya mtu wa kiume kila siku yanaweza kuimarishwa au kupunguzwa na mwanamke katika maisha yake. Imesema “Nyuma ya kila mwanaume aliyefanikiwa kuna mwanamke”. Mwanaume anaathiriwa sana kwa mema au mabaya na wanawake waliomo katika maisha yake.

Kwa ajili ya Kanisa:

Mwanamke wa imani, kanisa linakuhitaji. Wanawake huleta neema kwa kanisa ambayo inahitajika kwa dharura. Maombi yako yanahitajika. Ushuhuda wako hutoa faraja. Wimbo wako unaguswa mioyo yetu. Tabasamu lako linalotoa matumaini. Uso wako wenye amani na furaha wa roho iliyopumzika ndani ya Yesu ni ushawishi ambao hauwezi kulinganishwa kwa kitu kinginechoshi katika dunia hii.

“My, it’s warm!” exclaimed Mom. “A nice, good rain is what we need to cool things off a bit.”

It was Saturday, near the end of June, and the weather had been particularly hot and humid that day. Ellie’s mother had been cleaning the house and preparing some food for the company that was invited to come for lunch on Sunday after church.

As the afternoon moved into early evening, it felt like it became even hotter, and no breezes were to be found. Ellie’s father was resting in a hammock out on the lawn while the rest of the family tried to find the most comfortable place to seek relief from the heat.

As evening approached, so did the clouds. They arrived suddenly, along with gusts of wind that began to stir up the dust. Lightning started to flash across the sky and the thunder rumbled in the distance.

“Quickly, children!” called Mom. “Put away your toys; it’s about to storm!”

Ellie looked around in alarm. It was getting dark very quickly and the sky looked strange—almost angry. She quickly gathered up her playthings and hurried into the house. Dad was no longer sleeping on the hammock. The wind had almost toppled it over and him along with it! He, too, hurried into the house; the wind causing the door to slam violently behind him. The family gathered on the sunporch to watch the approaching storm. There were windows to the west and south, so they had a good vantage point from which to watch the coming rain. The wind was blowing with a force that Ellie had never experienced in all her seven years. She noted the concern and alarm on her parents’ faces as they watched and waited.

Then it began to rain. Great sheets of rain were being driven against the windows and Ellie wondered if it was possible that it was raining hard enough to break the glass.

“What was that?” exclaimed Mom as suddenly, a sheet of tin whizzed past the sunporch windows and disappeared beyond the garden.

“I think it’s part of the garage roof,” said Dad in disbelief while peering cautiously through the windows.

Upon hearing this, Mom directed the children to stand by the cellar door. If things got worse, down they would go! Ellie felt so scared. What was going to happen to them? Would their house blow away? Would any of them get hurt?

As abruptly as the storm began, it calmed. The wind stopped, the rain slowed, and very soon the sun was shining again. The family cautiously ventured outdoors to see what all had happened during the storm.

“Look!” said Dad. “The garage roof is gone and so is the south wall!”

“Why does Gerald’s house look so strange?” Mom pointed toward their next-door neighbors. “Why, look! The entire roof is gone from their house!” Indeed, the roof had been cleanly stripped away and the gable ends stoically stood there, holding up nothing.

The wail of sirens could be heard in the distance and as they looked around the neighborhood, they could see smoke just beyond some trees.

“That’s got to be Melvin’s barn burning!” exclaimed Dad. “I’m going to go see what I can do to help.” He raced for his truck and was soon hurrying out the driveway.

The winds had been so strong that some electric poles were blown over causing the electricity to be disconnected so there were no lights or fans. After the storm had passed the humidity and heat had returned making the night hot and muggy. Yet the grown-ups from the area worked long into the night, helping each other to clean up what they could of the storm damage.

Of special interest was our neighbor Melvin. His barn had collapsed on top of dozens of cattle and then a fire had broken out. The neighbor men tried desperately to rescue what cattle they could, but in the end, many of the steers could not be saved.

Sunday came, but no one went to church. The morning was spent over at Melvin’s, hauling away dead cattle, clearing away burnt hay, and simply just being there for one another. It was hard, grim work. Ellie clearly remembers how awful the smell was. And she could barely bring herself to watch the loading up of the dead steers. When lunch time came, their company arrived, but no one was very hungry. Ellie’s younger brother sobbed, “All I can think about is those poor steers!”

Ellie was surprised how powerful a storm could be. And scary! Would they experience another twister? Might more buildings collapse, and another barn or house burn down? A seed of fear began to grow in Ellie’s heart. Throughout that summer and for many summers after, every time the rumble of thunder was heard or she heard the words “tornado warning”, her heart would beat faster, and a knot would settle in her stomach. How she dreaded each storm! She wished they would all just pass by their home. Why did God allow storms, anyway?

“You need to trust God, Ellie,” her mother would say. “He’s the One who made the weather, and He is in control of everything that happens. He might not always keep us from experiencing frightening times, but He is always there to take care of us.”

As she grew older, Ellie learned to take this advice to heart. Her fear of storms faded, and, in its place, she developed a fascination with how storms develop and form. Knowing that God is the Master of the wind is still a comfort and an assurance to her. Most of all, as she has learned to trust God in every area of her life, she has found Him to always be faithful. Learning to replace fear with trust always brings peace to the heart.

“کتنا گرم ہے!” ماں نے کہا۔ “اچھا، ایک اچھی بارش ہی تو چاہیے تاکہ تھوڑی ٹھنڈک آئے۔”

یہ ہفتے کا دن تھا، جون کے آخر کے قریب، اور اُس دن خاص طور پر گرمی اور نمی زیادہ تھی۔ ایلی کی ماں گھر صاف کر رہی تھیں اور اتوار کو چرچ کے بعد دوپہر کے کھانے کے لیے آئے جانے والوں کے لیے کچھ کھانا تیار کر رہی تھیں۔

جب دوپہر شام میں بدل رہی تھی تو لگ رہا تھا کہ گرمی اور بڑھ گئی ہے اور ہوا کا ایک جھونکا بھی محسوس نہیں ہو رہا تھا۔ ایلی کا باپ لان میں ہیموک میں آرام کر رہا تھا جبکہ باقی خاندان گرمی سے کچھ راحت پانے کے لیے سب سے آرام دہ جگہ تلاش کرنے کی کوشش کر رہے تھے۔

جیسے جیسے شام قریب آئی، بادل بھی آئے۔ وہ اچانک آئے، ساتھ ہی تیز ہوائیں بھی آئیں جنہوں نے گرد اٹھا دی۔ آسمان پر بجلی چمکنے لگی اور دور کہیں تیز گرج سنائی دی۔

“جلدی، بچوں!” ماں نے پکارا۔ “اپنے کھلونے رکھ دو؛ طوفان آنے والا ہے!”

ایلی نے ڈرتے ہوئے اردگرد دیکھا۔ بہت تیزی سے اندھیرا ہو رہا تھا اور آسمان عجیب—کم وبیش غصے میں—لگ رہا تھا۔ وہ فوراً اپنے کھلونے جمع کر کے گھر کی طرف دوڑی۔ والد ہیموک پر اب سو نہیں رہے تھے۔ ہوا نے ہیموک کو تقریباً الٹا کر دیا تھا اور وہ بھی گرنے والا تھا! وہ بھی جلدی سے گھر میں آیا؛ ہوا نے دروازہ زور سے بند کر دیا۔ خاندان سن پورچ پر جمع ہو گیا تاکہ آنے والے طوفان کو دیکھ سکیں۔ وہاں مغرب اور جنوب کی طرف کھڑکیاں تھیں، اس لیے انہیں بارش کے آتے دیکھنے کی اچھی جگہ مل گئی۔ وہ ہوا کی طاقت دیکھ کر حیران تھا جو ایلی نے اپنی سات سالہ عمر میں کبھی محسوس نہیں کی تھی۔ اس نے اپنے والدین کے چہروں پر فکرمندی اور تشویش نوٹ کی جب وہ دیکھ رہے تھے اور انتظار کر رہے تھے۔

پھر بارش شروع ہو گئی۔ تیز بارش کھڑکیوں پر آ کر ٹک رہی تھی اور ایلی نے سوچا کہ کیا یہ اتنی تیز ہے کہ شیشے تک ٹوٹ جائے گی۔

“یہ کیا تھا؟” ماں نے حیرت سے کہا جب اچانک ایک ٹِن کی شیٹ سن پورچ کی کھڑکیوں کے پاس سے سرسرا کر گزر گئی اور باغ کے پار نظر نہ آئی۔

“میرا خیال ہے یہ گاڑی خانے کی چھت کا حصہ ہے,” باپ نے شکوک و شبہ کے ساتھ کہا اور احتیاط سے کھڑکیوں سے جھانکا۔

یہ سن کر ماں نے بچوں کو تہہ خانے کے دروازے کے پاس کھڑا ہونے کو کہا۔ اگر حالات خراب ہوئے تو وہ نیچے چلے جائیں گے! ایلی بہت ڈری ہوئی محسوس کر رہی تھی۔ ان کے ساتھ کیا ہونے والا ہے؟ کیا ان کا گھر اڑا جائے گا؟ کیا کسی کو چوٹ آئے گی؟

جتنی اچانک طوفان آیا تھا، اتنی ہی اچانک وہ تھم گیا۔ ہوا رک گئی، بارش کم ہوئی، اور بہت جلد سورج پھر چمکنے لگا۔ خاندان احتیاط سے باہر نکلا تاکہ دیکھے کہ طوفان کے دوران کیا کچھ ہوا تھا۔

“دیکھو!” باپ نے کہا۔ “گاڑی خانے کی چھت غائب ہے اور جنوب کی دیوار بھی!”

“جیرالڈ کے گھر کیسا عجیب دکھ رہا ہے؟” ماں نے اپنے ہمسائے کی طرف اشارہ کیا۔ “دیکھو! ان کے گھر کی پوری چھت غائب ہو گئی ہے!” واقعی، چھت صاف طور پر اتر گئی تھی اور گبل اینڈ بے تکلف کھڑے تھے، جو کچھ بھی سہارا دینے کے لیے کچھ نہیں رکھ رہے تھے۔

دور کہیں سائرن کی وایٔل سنائی دے رہی تھی اور جب انہوں نے محلے میں ادھر ادھر دیکھا تو کچھ درختوں کے پار دھواں نظر آیا۔

“وہ تو میلون کے کھیت کا عمار جل رہا ہے!” باپ نے کہا۔ “میں دیکھنے جا رہا ہوں کہ میں کیسے مدد کر سکتا ہوں۔” وہ اپنی ٹرک کی طرف دوڑا اور جلد ہی ڈرائیو وے سے نکل گیا۔

ہوائیں اتنی تیز تھیں کہ کچھ بجلی کے کھمبے اکھڑ گئے جس کی وجہ سے بجلی منقطع ہو گئی لہٰذا روشنی یا پنکھے نہیں تھے۔ طوفان کے گزر جانے کے بعد نمی اور گرمی پھر لوٹ آئی جس نے رات کو گرم اور بھاری بنا دیا۔ پھر بھی علاقے کے بالغ افراد رات دیر تک ایک دوسرے کی مدد کرتے رہے، جو طوفان کی نشانات صاف کر سکتے تھے وہ کر رہے تھے۔

خاص طور پر ہمارے ہمسائے میلون کی حالت سنجیدہ تھی۔ اس کا کھیت درجنوں مویشوں کے اوپر گر گیا اور پھر آگ لگ گئی۔ پڑوسی مرد مویشوں کو بچانے کی کوشش میں جان لگاتے رہے، مگر آخرکار بہت سے بانسریاں بچائی نہیں جاسکیں۔

اتوار آ گیا، مگر کوئی چرچ نہیں گیا۔ صبح میلون کے پاس گزری، مردہ مویشیں ہٹائی گئیں، جلی ہوئی گھاس صاف کی گئی، اور بس ایک دوسرے کے ساتھ وہاں رہ کر مدد کی گئی۔ یہ مشکل، دل خراش کام تھا۔ ایلی کو واضح طور پر یاد ہے کہ بدبو کتنی بھیاںک تھی۔ اور وہ بمشکل مردہ بانسریوں کو لوڈ ہوتے دیکھ سکتی تھی۔ جب دوپہر کا وقت آیا تو مہمان آئے، مگر کسی کو بھوک زیادہ محسوس نہیں ہوئی۔ ایلی کا چھوٹا بھائی روتے ہوئے بولا، “میرا دل صرف اُن غریب بانسریوں کے بارے میں سوچ رہا ہے!”

ایلی حیران تھی کہ طوفان کتنے طاقتور ہو سکتے ہیں۔ اور خوفناک! کیا انہیں ایک اور بگولا دیکھنا پڑے گا؟ کیا زیادہ عمارتیں گر سکتی ہیں، اور کوئی اور کھیت یا گھر جل سکتا ہے؟ ایلی کے دل میں خوف کا ایک بیج اُبھرنے لگا۔ اُس موسم گرما اور کئی بعد کے گرمیوں میں بھی، جب بھی گرج کی گونج سنائی دیتی یا وہ الفاظ “ٹورنیڈو وارننگ” سنتی، اس کا دل تیز دھڑکتا اور معدے میں گانٹھ بن جاتی۔ وہ ہر طوفان سے کتنی ڈر جاتی تھی! وہ چاہتی تھی کہ یہ سب بس ان کے گھر سے گزر جائیں۔ خدا نے طوفانوں کی اجازت کیوں دی؟

“تمہیں خدا پر بھروسہ کرنا چاہیے، ایلی,” اس کی ماں کہتی تھیں۔ “وہی ہے جس نے موسم بنایا ہے، اور وہ ہر شے پر قابو پاتا ہے۔ وہ ہمیشہ ہمیں خوفناک اوقات سے بچائے گا، یہ ضروری نہیں—مگر وہ ہمیشہ ہمارے خیال رکھنے کے لیے موجود ہے۔”

جب وہ بڑی ہوئی تو ایلی نے اس نصیحت کو دل سے مانا۔ اس کا طوفانوں کا خوف کم ہو گیا، اور اس کی جگہ طوفانوں کے بننے اور ترقی پانے میں ایک دلچسپی نے لے لی۔ یہ جان کر کہ خدا ہوا کا مالک ہے، اس کے لیے اب بھی سکون اور یقین کی بات ہے۔ سب سے بڑھ کر، جیسا کہ اس نے اپنی زندگی کے ہر شعبے میں خدا پر بھروسہ کرنا سیکھا، اس نے پایا کہ وہ ہمیشہ وفادار رہا ہے۔ خوف کو بھروسے سے بدلنا ہمیشہ دل کو سکون دیتا ہے۔

“My, it’s warm!” exclaimed Mom. “A nice, good rain is what we need to cool things off a bit.”

It was Saturday, near the end of June, and the weather had been particularly hot and humid that day. Ellie’s mother had been cleaning the house and preparing some food for the company that was invited to come for lunch on Sunday after church.

As the afternoon moved into early evening, it felt like it became even hotter, and no breezes were to be found. Ellie’s father was resting in a hammock out on the lawn while the rest of the family tried to find the most comfortable place to seek relief from the heat.

As evening approached, so did the clouds. They arrived suddenly, along with gusts of wind that began to stir up the dust. Lightning started to flash across the sky and the thunder rumbled in the distance.

“Quickly, children!” called Mom. “Put away your toys; it’s about to storm!”

Ellie looked around in alarm. It was getting dark very quickly and the sky looked strange—almost angry. She quickly gathered up her playthings and hurried into the house. Dad was no longer sleeping on the hammock. The wind had almost toppled it over and him along with it! He, too, hurried into the house; the wind causing the door to slam violently behind him. The family gathered on the sunporch to watch the approaching storm. There were windows to the west and south, so they had a good vantage point from which to watch the coming rain. The wind was blowing with a force that Ellie had never experienced in all her seven years. She noted the concern and alarm on her parents’ faces as they watched and waited.

Then it began to rain. Great sheets of rain were being driven against the windows and Ellie wondered if it was possible that it was raining hard enough to break the glass.

“What was that?” exclaimed Mom as suddenly, a sheet of tin whizzed past the sunporch windows and disappeared beyond the garden.

“I think it’s part of the garage roof,” said Dad in disbelief while peering cautiously through the windows.

Upon hearing this, Mom directed the children to stand by the cellar door. If things got worse, down they would go! Ellie felt so scared. What was going to happen to them? Would their house blow away? Would any of them get hurt?

As abruptly as the storm began, it calmed. The wind stopped, the rain slowed, and very soon the sun was shining again. The family cautiously ventured outdoors to see what all had happened during the storm.

“Look!” said Dad. “The garage roof is gone and so is the south wall!”

“Why does Gerald’s house look so strange?” Mom pointed toward their next-door neighbors. “Why, look! The entire roof is gone from their house!” Indeed, the roof had been cleanly stripped away and the gable ends stoically stood there, holding up nothing.

The wail of sirens could be heard in the distance and as they looked around the neighborhood, they could see smoke just beyond some trees.

“That’s got to be Melvin’s barn burning!” exclaimed Dad. “I’m going to go see what I can do to help.” He raced for his truck and was soon hurrying out the driveway.

The winds had been so strong that some electric poles were blown over causing the electricity to be disconnected so there were no lights or fans. After the storm had passed the humidity and heat had returned making the night hot and muggy. Yet the grown-ups from the area worked long into the night, helping each other to clean up what they could of the storm damage.

Of special interest was our neighbor Melvin. His barn had collapsed on top of dozens of cattle and then a fire had broken out. The neighbor men tried desperately to rescue what cattle they could, but in the end, many of the steers could not be saved.

Sunday came, but no one went to church. The morning was spent over at Melvin’s, hauling away dead cattle, clearing away burnt hay, and simply just being there for one another. It was hard, grim work. Ellie clearly remembers how awful the smell was. And she could barely bring herself to watch the loading up of the dead steers. When lunch time came, their company arrived, but no one was very hungry. Ellie’s younger brother sobbed, “All I can think about is those poor steers!”

Ellie was surprised how powerful a storm could be. And scary! Would they experience another twister? Might more buildings collapse, and another barn or house burn down? A seed of fear began to grow in Ellie’s heart. Throughout that summer and for many summers after, every time the rumble of thunder was heard or she heard the words “tornado warning”, her heart would beat faster, and a knot would settle in her stomach. How she dreaded each storm! She wished they would all just pass by their home. Why did God allow storms, anyway?

“You need to trust God, Ellie,” her mother would say. “He’s the One who made the weather, and He is in control of everything that happens. He might not always keep us from experiencing frightening times, but He is always there to take care of us.”

As she grew older, Ellie learned to take this advice to heart. Her fear of storms faded, and, in its place, she developed a fascination with how storms develop and form. Knowing that God is the Master of the wind is still a comfort and an assurance to her. Most of all, as she has learned to trust God in every area of her life, she has found Him to always be faithful. Learning to replace fear with trust always brings peace to the heart.

“Ehe, ni joto!” Mama alilia. “Mvua nzuri, ya kutosha itakayopoa kidogo ndiyo tunahitaji.”

Ilikuwa Jumamosi, karibu mwisho wa Juni, na hali ya hewa ilikuwa ya joto kali na yenye unyevunyevu siku hiyo. Mama wa Ellie alikuwa akiweka nyumba safi na kuandaa chakula kwa ajili ya wageni waliokuwa wamealikwa kuja kwa chakula cha mchana siku ya Jumapili baada ya ibada.

Wakati mchana ulipokuwa ukielekea jioni, ilihisi kama ikawa joto zaidi, na hakuna upepo wa kupendeza uliopatikana. Baba wa Ellie alikuwa akipumzika kwenye mtaro nje kwenye uwanja wakati familia yote ilijaribu kupata sehemu yenye msongamano mdogo zaidi ili kupata faraja kutokana na joto.

Wakati jioni ilipokaribia, mawingu nayo yalifika. Yalikuja ghafla, pamoja na milipuko ya upepo iliyokuwa ikianza kukusanya vumbi. Umeme ulianza kung'aa angani na radi ikalizia mbali, ikikaanga mbawa kwa umbali.

“Haraka, watoto!” Mama alipiga mlio. “Weka mbali vitu vyenu vya kuchezea; mvua inakaribia!”

Ellie alitazama kwa hofu. Ilikuwa ikizimia haraka sana na anga lilionekana la ajabu—takriban hasira. Alikusanya kwa haraka vitu vyake vya kuchezea na kukimbia ndani ya nyumba. Baba hakuwahi tena kulala kwenye mtaro. Upepo ulikuwa karibu kuufyatua pamoja naye! Yeye pia alikimbia ndani ya nyumba; upepo ulisababisha mlango kufungwa kwa nguvu nyuma yake. Familia ilikusanyika kwenye veranda kuona dhoruba inayokaribia. Kulikuwa na madirisha upande wa magharibi na kusini, hivyo walikuwa na nafasi nzuri ya kutazama mvua inayokuja. Upepo ulikua kwa nguvu ambayo Ellie hakuwahi kuiona katika miaka yake saba yote. Aliona wasiwasi na hofu kwenye nyuso za wazazi wake walipokuwa wakitazama na kusubiri.

Kisha ilianza kunyesha. Mavazi makubwa ya mvua yalikuwa yakipigwa dhidi ya madirisha na Ellie alijiuliza kama inawezekana mvua ilikuwa ikinyesha kwa nguvu kiasi kwamba ingeweza kuvunja kioo.

“Ile nini hicho?” Mama alikemea ghafla, kifunika cha bati kiliporota mbele ya madirisha ya veranda na kutoweka kando ya bustani.

“Nadhani ni sehemu ya paa la gereji,” Baba alisema asiyekiona vya wazi huku akitizama kwa tahadhari kupitia madirisha.

Aliposikia hayo, Mama aliwaagiza watoto wamesimame kando ya mlango wa ghorofa ya chini. Ikiwa mambo yangeendelea kuwa mabaya, wangepanda chini! Ellie alihisi woga sana. Nini kitatokea kwao? Je, nyumba yao itavuliwa na upepo? Je, yeyote atapata majeraha?

Kama vile dhoruba ilivyoanza ghafla, ilitulia. Upepo ukasimama, mvua ikapungua, na hivi karibuni jua lilikuwa liking'aa tena. Familia kwa tahadhari walienda nje kuona kilichotokea wakati wa dhoruba.

“Tazama!” Baba alisema. “Paa la gereji lipo mbali na ukuta wa kusini pia umeondoka!”

“Kwa nini nyumba ya Gerald inaonekana ya ajabu?” Mama alionyesha kuelekea kwa majirani wao wa upande. “Angalia! Paa lote limeondolewa kabisa kutoka kwenye nyumba yao!” Kwa kweli, paa lilikuwa limeondolewa kabisa na ncha za gable zilikaa pale, zikinyanyua hewa bila kuunga kitu chochote.

Kelele za sirens zilisikika kwa mbali na walipotazama jirani, waliweza kuona moshi kando ya miti.

“Hiyo lazima iwe banda la Melvin linalowaka!” Baba alipigina. “Nitakuja kuona ni kitu gani ninaweza kufanya kusaidia.” Alikimbia hadi kwa lori lake na hivi karibuni alikuwa akikimbia njiani.

Upepo ulikuwa hivyo kwa nguvu kiasi kwamba baadhi ya nguzo za umeme zilifunguka na kusababisha umeme kuzimwa hivyo hakukuwa na taa wala mashabiki. Baada ya dhoruba kupita, unyevunyevu na joto vilirudi na kufanya usiku kuwa wa joto na mnyevunyevu. Hata hivyo watu wazima wa eneo hilo walifanya kazi kwa muda mrefu usiku kucha, wakisaidiana kusafisha kilichoweza kufanyika kutokana na uharibifu wa dhoruba.

Mtu wa pekee aliyekuwa mwenye masikitiko maalum alikuwa jirani wetu Melvin. Banda lake lilikuwa limejikunja juu ya ng'ombe mamia kadhaa na kisha moto ukaanza. Wanaume majirani walijaribu kwa nguvu kumwokoa ng'ombe walizoweza, lakini mwishowe, ng'ombe wengi hawakuweza kuokolewa.

Jumapili ilifika, lakini hakuna aliyekwenda kanisani. Asubuhi ilitumika nyumbani kwa Melvin, wakichukua ng'ombe waliokufa, kusafisha nyasi zilizochomwa, na kuwa pamoja kwa kila mmoja. Ilikuwa kazi ngumu, iliyoleta huzuni. Ellie anakumbuka wazi jinsi ilivyokuwa mbaya harufu. Na karibu hakuweza kustahimili kutazama kupakiwa kwa ng'ombe waliokufa. Wakati wa chakula cha mchana wageni wao walifika, lakini hakuna aliyekuwa na hamu ya kula. Kaka mdogo wa Ellie alilia, “Kitu pekee ninachoweza kufikiri ni zile ng'ombe maskini!”

Ellie alishangazwa jinsi dhoruba inaweza kuwa yenye nguvu. Na kuogesha! Je, wangeweza kupata kimbunga kingine? Je, majengo mengine yangeanguka, na bande au nyumba nyingine zingewaka? Mbegu ya hofu ilianza kukua moyoni mwa Ellie. Wakati wote wa majira hayo na kwa majira mengi yaliyofuata, kila mara aliwasikia radi kupiga au kuambiwa “onyo la tornado”, moyo wake ulipiga kwa nguvu, na tumbo lake likaanza kujaa fimbo. Alivyokuwa anahofu kila dhoruba! Alitamani zote zingepita tu karibu na nyumba yao. Mbona Mungu anaruhusu dhoruba, hata hivyo?

“Unahitaji kumwamini Mungu, Ellie,” mama yake angeeleza. “Yeye ndiye Aliyemuumba hali ya hewa, na Yeye ndiye mtawala wa kila kitu kinachotokea. Huwezi tu kutuokoa kila wakati kwa kipindi cha kuogopesha, lakini yeye daima yupo kututunza.”

Alipokuwa akikua, Ellie alijifunza kuchukua ushauri huu kwa moyo. Hofu yake ya dhoruba ilipungua, na, badala yake, alianzisha kuvutiwa na jinsi dhoruba zinavyoanza na kuunda. Kujua kwamba Mungu ndiye Mwana wa upepo bado ni faraja na hakikisho kwake. Zaidi ya yote, alipojifunza kumwamini Mungu katika kila eneo la maisha yake, alimwona daima mwaminifu. Kujifunza kubadilisha hofu kuwa uaminifu daima huleta amani moyoni.

For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy … For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife? –1 Corinthians 7:14-16.

As we gaze across the thoroughfare of homes surrounding us, we grieve as we behold one Christian tragedy after another. Almost every Christian has some near kin who has experienced divorce, a rebellious child, or strained marital relationships. Perhaps we cry out to God as we wonder why it is so, for it is surely not His plan. Herein we behold the apostle Paul bringing out an amazing principle that is little understood and even less employed—a sanctified home. It is what every sincere believer wants and seeks, but few apprehend. Christianity is not a rubber stamp that automatically clones offspring after the same sort. Still the scripture must be true and there must indeed be a sanctifying effect that a true believer brings into a home. This is no guarantee that the unbelieving spouse or the children of the union will be saved, but when a believing husband or wife acts in accordance with the scripture and the Spirit of God, the effect they have on the home will allow God’s power to be evident and an avenue of grace is poured into the pathway of all who dwell therein.

Our impotency is not caused due to the lack of God’s power, but because our dim understanding is infested and infiltrated with the influences of this present world. Faith in God alone is inevitably a powerful force, while faith injected by human reasoning and impatience will hardly prove any more effective than Abraham and Hagar’s attempts to produce a holy and sanctified child.

What then sanctifies the home? Casual observation will notice that merely being a believer isn’t enough to accomplish it. To sanctify is to make pure and holy. It is a process of filtering and a separation from that which is impure to bring greater purity to the object being sanctified. The Pharisees understood the principle well. They spent many a rigorous hour paying heed to countless miniscule details to make their vessels holy. Still, they were critically unsuccessful.

Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess. Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also –Matthew 23:25-26.

The Inside Sanctified by Faith and Prayer

What a foolish thing it would be for a man to wash only the outside of a cup, which is to be looked at, and to leave the inside dirty, which is to be used. Yet there are those who avoid only the scandalous sins—those that would spoil their reputation with men—but would still allow themselves pride and moral decay in their heart. It is this which renders them odious to the pure and holy God. Such it is when a man or woman seeks to purify their home by superficial cleansing. Pharisaic attempts to root out and remove the surface details and inconsistencies from the lives of their helpmate and children, in order to sanctify them, are generally fruitless.

However quick-sighted they are in other things; Christ calls them blind. In Christ’s estimation, those who are not acquainted with the wickedness of their own hearts—those who see not, and hate not, the secret sin that is lodged within—are strangers to sanctification. Self-ignorance is the most shameful and hurtful ignorance. The rule is, “Cleanse first that which is within, to get cleansed from the filthiness of the spirit.” Corrupt affections and inclinations, the secret lusts that lurk in the soul, unseen and unobserved, these must first be recognized, mortified, and subdued. If due care is taken concerning that, the outside will, by extension, become clean also. External motives and inducements may keep the outside clean, while the inside remains filthy; but if renewed sanctifying grace makes the inside clean, that will have a lasting and profound influence upon the outside, for the commanding principle is within. If the heart is well kept, all is well, …for out of it are the issues of life –Proverbs 4:23.

Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives; While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear. Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel; But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price. For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement. Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered –1 Peter 3:1-7.

Here Peter speaks of a wife winning her husband with the due benevolence mentioned in Corinthians. While she has no unconditional guarantee of sanctifying her husband, she certainly will meet with little success without it. Eunice was a Jewess, who, upon embracing faith in Christ, found herself in an unequal yoke with a Greek. We read that unfeigned faith was first wrought in her mother Lois, and that affected Eunice. This, in turn, had a sanctifying effect on young Timothy, who was then prepared for the work of the Lord. We have no record that his father was added to the faith, but one can only imagine the initial turmoil within the breast of this young Jewess as she reverently honored her head and circumcised not her son but rather committed him to prayer. Here brings us to the other vital dimension of home sanctification. While she was not emboldened to teach her husband, she apparently had won his respect enough to allow her to teach her son in the home. This she diligently did… For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer –1 Timothy 4:5.

And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus. All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness –2 Timothy 3:15-16.

The Outside Sanctified by the Word

When the heart of the believer is dealt with first, the visible dimensions of the home fall into place in succession. Worldly influences have little appeal for the budding child of God. The Word of God must take its full place being administered to the children as well as the adults, for they are profitable for sanctification. A husband is to wash his wife and children (as well as himself) by administering the Word of God so that he may sanctify and cleanse his home.

Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish –Ephesians 5:25-27.

When the Word of God is given full authority in the home, it becomes the governing principle around which the home operates. It must be allowed to filter out the media of the masses and the influences of all evil communications, which will corrupt good manners.

Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful –Psalm 1:1.

Individuals within the home may not always appreciate the direction received from it, but submit to it they must, and usually do so heartily. Most of us have received direction from our parents that we did not appreciate at the time but years later have come to grasp the blessedness of their leadership. Leadership that does not lead, is not expressing love, and will leave the home unsanctified and its members disconnected. Though it is rather uncomfortable and inconvenient to ask children to do without what others are partaking in, they are not sanctified by following their peers, but rather by the truth. For us as parents, there is no greater joy than to know that our children walk in truth. Equally so, there is no greater joy for them than to walk in it. Daily family devotions are a cohesive force within the home that is central and integral to home sanctification. We dare not apologize for the authority we give to the Word, nor slack from its use. It is an erroneous Gospel to believe that souls are stifled who are held to the mandates within it.

Here is Christ’s summation of His home.

I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word. Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee. For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me. I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine. And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them. And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are. While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled. And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves. I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world. I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil. They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world. Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth –John 17:6-17.

Christ, as the head of His home, employed no complicated means to the sanctification of His children. His life manifested a constant keeping Himself in the love of God through faith and prayer, and the administration of God’s Word to those about Him. At times they stumbled at it, wrestled inwardly, and misunderstood Him, but the keeping force rested not on the laurels of convincing words, adamant force, fun activities, nor prudent reasoning.

While a home must employ these resources from time to time, they of themselves do not carry the sanctifying power. For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer –1 Timothy 4:5.

Διότι ο άπιστος σύζυγος είναι αγιασμένος από τη γυναίκα, και η άπιστη σύζυγος αγιάζεται από τον άνδρα· αλλιώς τα παιδιά σας θα ήσαν ακάθαρτα· τώρα όμως είναι ἁγία … Τί οίδεις, γύναι, εάν σώσεις τον άνδρα σου; ή τί οίδεις, άνδρα, εάν σώσεις τη γυναίκα σου; –1 Κορινθίους 7:14-16.

Καθώς κοιτάζουμε πέρα στο δρόμο των σπιτιών που μας περιβάλλουν, λυπόμαστε καθώς βλέπουμε το ένα χριστιανικό δράμα μετά το άλλο. Σχεδόν κάθε χριστιανός έχει κάποιον κοντινό συγγενή που πέρασε διαζύγιο, κάποιο αποστατημένο παιδί ή εντριβές στον γάμο. Ίσως φωνάζουμε προς τον Θεό αναρωτώμενοι γιατί συμβαίνει αυτό, διότι σίγουρα δεν είναι σχέδιό Του. Εδώ βλέπουμε τον απόστολο Παύλο να αναδεικνύει μια εκπληκτική αρχή που είναι λίγο κατανοητή και ακόμη λιγότερο εφαρμόσιμη—ένα αγιασμένο σπίτι. Είναι αυτό που κάθε ειλικρινής πιστός θέλει και επιδιώκει, αλλά λίγοι αντιλαμβάνονται. Ο χριστιανισμός δεν είναι σφραγίδα που αυτόματα κλωνοποιεί τα παιδιά κατά τον ίδιο τρόπο. Ωστόσο η γραφή πρέπει να είναι αληθινή και πράγματι πρέπει να υπάρχει ένα αγιάζον αποτέλεσμα που ένας αληθινός πιστός φέρνει σε ένα σπίτι. Αυτό δεν αποτελεί εγγύηση ότι ο άπιστος σύζυγος ή τα παιδιά της ένωσης θα σωθούν, αλλά όταν ένας πιστός σύζυγος ή σύζυγος ενεργεί σύμφωνα με τη γραφή και το Πνεύμα του Θεού, η επίδραση που έχουν στο σπίτι θα επιτρέψει στη δύναμη του Θεού να γίνει εμφανής και ένας δρόμος χάριτος θα χυθεί στο μονοπάτι όλων όσων κατοικούν εκεί.

Η ανικανότητά μας δεν οφείλεται στην έλλειψη της δύναμης του Θεού, αλλά επειδή η συγκεχυμένη κατανόησή μας είναι μολυσμένη και διεισδυμένη από τις επιδράσεις του παρόντος κόσμου. Η πίστη μόνο στον Θεό είναι αναπόφευκτα μια ισχυρή δύναμη, ενώ η πίστη που εγχέεται από ανθρώπινη λογική και ανυπομονησία ελάχιστα θα αποδειχθεί πιο αποτελεσματική από τις προσπάθειες του Αβραάμ και της Αγαρ να παράγουν ένα ἁγιο και αγιασμένο παιδί.

Τι λοιπόν αγιάζει το σπίτι; Η επιπόλαια παρατήρηση θα προσέξει ότι το να είναι κάποιος απλώς πιστός δεν αρκεί για να το επιτύχει. Αγιάζειν σημαίνει να κάνεις καθαρό και ἁγιο. Είναι μια διαδικασία διήθησης και διαχωρισμού από το ακάθαρτο, ώστε να φέρει μεγαλύτερη καθαρότητα στο αντικείμενο που αγιάζεται. Οι Φαρισαίοι κατανοούσαν καλά την αρχή. Πέρασαν πολλές αυστηρές ώρες προσέχοντας αναρίθμητες ασήμαντες λεπτομέρειες για να κάνουν τα σκεύη τους ἁγιασμένα. Ωστόσο απέτυχαν κρίσιμα.

Ουαί σε σας, γραμματείες και Φαρισαίοι υποκριταί! διότι καθαρίζετε το εξωτερικό του ποτηρίου και του δίσκου, ενώ μέσα αυτά είναι γεμάτα εκμετάλλευση και υπερβολή. Ω τυφλέ Φαρισαίε, καθάρισον πρώτον το εντός του ποτηρίου και του δίσκου, ώστε να καθαρισθεί και το έξω αυτών –Ματθαίος 23:25-26.

Το Εσωτερικό Αγιάζεται με Πίστη και Προσευχή

Τι ανόητο θα ήταν για έναν άνδρα να πλένει μόνο το εξωτερικό ενός ποτηριού, που φαίνεται, και να αφήνει το εσωτερικό βρώμικο, που χρησιμοποιείται. Και όμως υπάρχουν εκείνοι που αποφεύγουν μόνο τα αισχρά αμαρτήματα—εκείνα που θα βλάψουν τη φήμη τους μπροστά στους ανθρώπους—αλλά θα επιτρέπουν στον εαυτό τους υπερηφάνεια και ηθική φθορά στην καρδιά τους. Αυτά τα πράγματα τα κάνουν αποκρουστικά στον καθαρό και ἁγιο Θεό. Αυτό συμβαίνει όταν ένας άνδρας ή μια γυναίκα προσπαθεί να καθαρίσει το σπίτι τους με επιφανειακή κάθαρση. Οι φαρισαϊκές προσπάθειες να ριζώσουν και να αφαιρέσουν τις επιφανειακές λεπτομέρειες και ασυνέπειες από τη ζωή του συζύγου/συζύγου και των παιδιών, για να τα αγιάσουν, γενικά είναι άκαρπες.

Όσο και αν έχουν οξυμένη όραση σε άλλα πράγματα· ο Χριστός τους αποκαλεί τυφλούς. Κατά την εκτίμηση του Χριστού, εκείνοι που δεν είναι εξοικειωμένοι με την κακία της δικής τους καρδιάς—εκείνοι που δεν βλέπουν, και δεν μισούν, την μυστική αμαρτία που είναι φυτεμένη μέσα—είναι ξένοι προς τον αγιασμό. Η άγνοια του εαυτού είναι η πιο ντροπιαστική και βλαβερή άγνοια. Ο κανόνας είναι, «Καθάρισε πρώτον το εντός, για να καθαρισθείς από τη ρυπαρότητα του πνεύματος.» Διαφθαρμένες στοργές και κλίσεις, οι μυστικές πόθοι που καραδοκούν στην ψυχή, αθέατες και απαρατήρητες, πρέπει πρώτα να αναγνωριστούν, να απονεκρωθούν και να υποταγούν. Αν ληφθεί η δέουσα φροντίδα για αυτό, το εξωτερικό θα γίνει, κατά επέκταση, και αυτό καθαρό. Εξωτερικά κίνητρα και προτροπές μπορεί να διατηρούν το έξω καθαρό, ενώ το μέσα παραμένει βρώμικο· αλλά αν η ανανεούμενη αγιάζουσα χάρη καθαρίσει το μέσα, αυτό θα έχει διαρκή και βαθιά επίδραση στο έξω, διότι η καθοδηγητική αρχή βρίσκεται εσωτερικά. Αν η καρδιά φυλάσσεται καλά, όλα είναι καλά, …διότι από αυτήν εξέρχονται οι πηγές της ζωής –Παροιμίες 4:23.

Ομοίως οι γυναίκες, υποτασσόμενες στους άνδρες τους· ώστε, αν μερικοί δεν υπακούουν στον λόγο, με την συμπεριφορά των γυναικών να κερδηθούν χωρίς λόγια· βλέποντας την αγνή συμπεριφορά σας μαζί με φόβο. Ο στολισμός σας να μην είναι εξωτερικός στολισμός πλέξης μαλλιών, χρυσών ή ενδυμάτων· αλλά ο κρυφός άνθρωπος της καρδιάς, ο άφθαρτος, ο στολισμός του πράου και σιωπηλού πνεύματος, πολύτιμου ενώπιον του Θεού. Έτσι και οι ιερές γυναίκες του παρελθόντος, που ελπίζαν στον Θεό, στολίζονταν υπακούοντας στους άνδρες τους· όπως η Σάρρα υπάκουε τον Αβραάμ, καλώντας τον κύριο· των οποίων είστε κόρες, εάν πράττετε καλά και δεν φοβάστε κανένα φόβητρο. Έτσι και οι άνδρες, κατοικήσατε με αυτές με γνώση, δίνοντας τιμή στη γυναίκα ως ασθενέστερο σκεύος και ως κληρονόμους μαζί της της χάριτος της ζωής· ώστε οι προσευχές σας να μην παρεμποδίζονται –1 Πέτρου 3:1-7.

Εδώ ο Πέτρος μιλάει για μια γυναίκα που κερδίζει τον άνδρα της με την οφειλόμενη καλοσύνη που αναφέρεται στην προς Κορινθίους επιστολή. Ενώ δεν έχει άνευ όρων εγγύηση ότι θα αγιάσει τον άνδρα της, σίγουρα θα έχει ελάχιστη επιτυχία χωρίς αυτήν. Η Ευνίκη ήταν Ιουδαία, η οποία, αφού ασπάστηκε την πίστη στον Χριστό, βρέθηκε σε άνισο ζυγό με έναν Έλληνα. Διαβάζουμε ότι αληθινή πίστη πρώτα δούλευε στη μητέρα της Λωΐδα, και αυτό επηρέασε την Ευνίκη. Αυτό, με τη σειρά του, είχε αγιάζουσα επίδραση στον νεαρό Τιμόθεο, που τότε ετοιμάστηκε για το έργο του Κυρίου. Δεν έχουμε καταγραφή ότι ο πατέρας του προστέθηκε στην πίστη, αλλά μπορεί κανείς να φανταστεί τα αρχικά αναταραχή στην ψυχή αυτής της νεαρής Ιουδαίας καθώς τίμησε ευλαβικά την προϊσταμένη της θέση και δεν περιέcircμως τον γιο της αλλά τον παρέδωσε στην προσευχή. Εδώ φέρνει εμάς στη άλλη ζωτική διάσταση του αγιάσματος του σπιτιού. Ενώ δεν είχε δύναμη να διδάξει τον άνδρα της, προφανώς κέρδισε αρκετό σεβασμό ώστε να της επιτρέπεται να διδάξει τον γιο της στο σπίτι. Αυτό επιμελώς το έκανε… Διότι αγιάζεται από τον λόγο του Θεού και την προσευχή –1 Τιμόθεο 4:5.

Και από παιδιόθεν γνώρισας τα ιερά γράμματα, τα οποία δύνανται να σε σοφίσουν προς σωτηρία μέσω της πίστεως που είναι εν Χριστώ Ιησού. Πάσα γραφή θεόπνευστος και ωφέλιμος για διδασκαλία, για έλεγχο, για διόρθωση, για παιδεία στην δικαιοσύνη –2 Τιμόθεο 3:15-16.

Το Εξωτερικό Αγιάζεται από τον Λόγο

Όταν η καρδιά του πιστού αντιμετωπίζεται πρώτα, οι ορατές διαστάσεις του σπιτιού τοποθετούνται στη συνέχεια στη σειρά. Οι κοσμικές επιρροές έχουν μικρή έλξη για το αναδυόμενο παιδί του Θεού. Ο Λόγος του Θεού πρέπει να λάβει την πλήρη του θέση, να χορηγείται στα παιδιά καθώς και στους ενήλικες, διότι είναι ωφέλιμος για τον αγιασμό. Ο σύζυγος πρέπει να πλένει τη γυναίκα και τα παιδιά του (όπως και τον εαυτό του) χορηγώντας τον Λόγο του Θεού, ώστε να μπορεί να αγιάσει και να καθαρίσει το σπίτι του.

Άνδρες, αγαπήσατε τις γυναίκες σας, καθώς και ο Χριστός αγάπησε την εκκλησία και παρέδωσε τον εαυτόν του γι' αυτήν, ώστε να την αγιάσει και να την καθαρίσει με το λουτρό του ύδατος δια του λόγου, για να παρουσιάσει την εαυτήν του ένδοξον εκκλησίαν, χωρις στίγμα ή ρυτίδα ή τοιαύτη, αλλά να είναι ἁγία και άμωμος –Εφεσίους 5:25-27.

Όταν ο Λόγος του Θεού έχει πλήρη εξουσία εντός του σπιτιού, γίνεται η κυβερνώσα αρχή γύρω από την οποία λειτουργεί το σπίτι. Πρέπει να του επιτραπεί να διηθήσει τα μέσα της μάζας και τις επιρροές όλων των κακών επικοινωνιών, που θα διαφθείρουν τους καλούς τρόπους.

Ευλογημένος ο άνθρωπος που δεν περπατάει κατά τη συμβουλή των ασεβών, ούτε στέκεται στο μονοπάτι των αμαρτωλών, ούτε κάθεται στη θέση των χλευαστών –Ψαλμός 1:1.

Τα άτομα μέσα στο σπίτι μπορεί να μην εκτιμούν πάντοτε την καθοδήγηση που λαμβάνουν από αυτό, αλλά πρέπει να υποτάσσονται και συνήθως το κάνουν με προθυμία. Οι περισσότεροι από εμάς έχουμε λάβει καθοδήγηση από τους γονείς μας που δεν εκτιμούσαμε εκείνη την εποχή αλλά χρόνια αργότερα είδαμε την ευλογημένη φύση της ηγεσίας τους. Η ηγεσία που δεν οδηγεί, δεν εκφράζει αγάπη, και θα αφήσει το σπίτι χωρίς αγιασμό και τα μέλη του αποσυνδεδεμένα. Αν και είναι μάλλον άβολο και δυσχερές να ζητήσεις από τα παιδιά να στερηθούν εκείνα που οι άλλοι απολαμβάνουν, αυτά δεν αγιάζονται ακολουθώντας τους συνομηλίκους τους, αλλά μάλλον την αλήθεια. Για εμάς ως γονείς, δεν υπάρχει μεγαλύτερη χαρά από το να ξέρουμε ότι τα παιδιά μας πορεύονται στην αλήθεια. Ομοίως, δεν υπάρχει μεγαλύτερη χαρά για αυτά από το να πορεύονται σε αυτήν. Οι καθημερινές οικογενειακές ακολουθίες είναι μια συνεκτική δύναμη μέσα στο σπίτι που είναι κεντρική και αναπόσπαστη στον αγιασμό του σπιτιού. Δεν τολμούμε να ζητήσουμε συγγνώμη για την εξουσία που δίνουμε στον Λόγο, ούτε να αμελήσουμε τη χρήση του. Είναι ένα λανθασμένο Ευαγγέλιο να πιστεύουμε ότι οι ψυχές πνίγονται αν τις συγκρατούμε στα απαιτούμενα που περιέχει.

Εδώ είναι η σύνοψη του Χριστού για το σπίτι Του.

Δόξασα το όνομά σου στους ανθρώπους που μου έδωσες από τον κόσμο· δικοί σου ήσαν και μου τους έδωσες· κι εκείνοι τήρησαν τον λόγον σου. Τώρα γνώρισαν ότι όλα όσα μου έδωσες είναι από σε. Διότι εγώ τους έδωκα τον λόγον που μου έδωσες· και τον εδέχθησαν και εγνώρισαν βεβαίως ότι εξηλθον από σε, και επίστευσαν ότι συ με απέστειλες. Προσεύχομαι υπέρ αυτών· δεν προσεύχομαι υπέρ του κόσμου, αλλά υπέρ εκείνων που μου έδωσας· διότι δικοί σου είναι. Και όλα τα δικά μου είναι δικά σου και τα δικά σου είναι δικά μου· και εγώ εδοξάσθην εν αυτοίς. Και τώρα δεν είμαι πλέον στον κόσμο, αλλά αυτοί είναι στον κόσμο, και έρχομαι σε σε. Άγιε Πατέρα, φύλαξον δια του ονόματός σου εκείνους που μου έδωσες, ώστε να είναι εν ω οιμεις. Όταν ήμουν με αυτούς στον κόσμο, εφύλαξα τους εν τω ονόματί σου· όσους μού έδωσες εφύλαξα, και ουδένα απ' αυτούς απώλεσα ειμή τον υιόν της απωλείας· ώστε να πραγματοποιηθή η γραφή. Και τώρα έρχομαι σε σε· και τα τοιαύτα λέγω εν τω κόσμω, ώστε η χαρά μου να είναι πλήρης εν αυτοίς. Τους έδωσα τον λόγον σου· και ο κόσμος τους εμίσησεν, διότι δεν είναι εκ του κόσμου, καθώς ούτε εγώ είμαι εκ του κόσμου. Δεν προσεύχομαι να τους αφαιρέσης εκ του κόσμου, αλλά να τους φυλάξης από το πονηρόν. Αυτοί δεν είναι εκ του κόσμου, καθώς ούτε εγώ είμαι εκ του κόσμου. Αγίασον αυτούς διά της αληθείας· ο λόγος σου είναι αλήθεια –Ιωάννης 17:6-17.

Greetings of Christian love to one and all. In this issue of the magazine (Summer 2023)… The Church History article focuses on Bible prophecy pertaining to the end times and some various ways that over the years certain elements of the church got off track from the Biblical teaching as it pertained to their everyday life. In his article, Donny Brechbill, who together with his wife teaches multiple marriage seminars each year, endeavors to zone in on a challenging subject—some of the root problems that they see with women who are struggling in the church. Lee Rufener takes an unapologetic approach in his effort to share some expository teaching on practical ways to have a sanctified home. We have a new writer for the sisters this time who shares a burden on her heart—instilling God’s Word in the hearts of the next generation.

Plus, more interesting topics. Enjoy.

If you are edified or encouraged by any of the authors’ content, it would be a blessing for you to respond to us by mail or email. We pass this along to our writers for their benefit.

Recently, I was pondering the subject of change. As I have written before, we have gone through a fair bit of change as a family. During the last 1 to 2 years, we moved to another place of residence, I acquired a new job, and finally, praise the Lord, I have mostly recovered from most of the long-term effects of Covid. A special thanks to each one who has prayed for my health.

As I paused in quiet reminiscence, I was surprised by all the things that have changed in the 40-plus years that I can recall from memory. (Even though I am over 50 I really don’t remember much from the earliest years of my life.)

As a boy, I rode around in vehicles that had no seat belts and for sure, no airbags. When both of those “lifesaving” devices were first being introduced I well remember the many discussions whether they were truly lifesaving in their effect or whether the opposite was true. All vehicles used to be rear-wheel drive or four-wheel drive. How odd it seemed when the first front-wheel drive cars started to appear. Now we have hybrid vehicles with a push towards fully electric vehicles.

Forty-plus years ago, most farmers had gas-powered tractors with a carburetor or a diesel tractor with a manually powered injector pump. Today, most tractors are equipped with a computer and seemingly miles of wires and electronic this and electronic that. Back then, most farmers were able to maintain or repair their own equipment; now there is a need for diagnostic machines and specialized tools which cost a lot of money and take many hours to learn how to operate. This causes most farmers to rely on the expertise of specialized repairmen which also cost a lot of money.

Then there was Covid. That was a stressful time. Have you noticed what has changed during, after, or as a result of Covid? As I interact with others, routinely someone will say that this or that is different since Covid. Is it just me, or since Covid is the general public less friendly and more private with their interactions? Let’s check our own interactions to ensure that we are still being God’s “light” and “salt” to this dark world, and that we are not losing our “saltiness”. Also, there are help wanted signs everywhere. Why? It seems to me that Covid has encouraged what little work ethic was still flourishing in our society to diminish even further.

Then there is the issue of cell phones and E-bikes. What do these two disconnected products have in common? From my vantage point observing the Amish of Holmes County, these two items have done more to change a people and a culture in a more major way than almost anything else has in recent times.

Where does this all leave us? The Hebrew writer says that For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law –Hebrews 7:12. So, we see that God changed things as He saw fit, thus, if we need to change to become more Biblical, then we should. But the Apostle Paul says That we [should] henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine… –Ephesians 4:14.

And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold. But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved –Matthew 24:12-13. So, let us be vigilant in these end times as change happens more and more around us. May we be among those who shall endure until the end.

Saluti di amore cristiano a tutti. In questo numero della rivista (estate 2023)… L'articolo di Storia della Chiesa si concentra sulla profezia biblica relativa agli ultimi tempi e su alcuni modi diversi in cui, nel corso degli anni, certi elementi della chiesa si sono allontanati dall'insegnamento biblico per quanto riguardava la loro vita quotidiana. Nel suo articolo, Donny Brechbill, che insieme a sua moglie tiene diversi seminari sul matrimonio ogni anno, si impegna a focalizzarsi su un argomento difficile—alcuni dei problemi di fondo che egli vede nelle donne che stanno lottando nella chiesa. Lee Rufener adotta un approccio senza scuse nel suo sforzo di condividere un insegnamento espositivo su modi pratici per avere una casa santificata. Questa volta abbiamo una nuova autrice per le sorelle che condivide un peso nel suo cuore—instillare la Parola di Dio nei cuori della prossima generazione.

Inoltre, altri argomenti interessanti. Buona lettura.

Se vieni edificato o incoraggiato dal contenuto di uno qualsiasi degli autori, sarebbe una benedizione per noi ricevere una tua risposta per posta o e‑mail. Lo inoltriamo ai nostri scrittori per il loro beneficio.

Di recente riflettevo sul tema del cambiamento. Come ho già scritto, come famiglia abbiamo attraversato un bel po' di cambiamenti. Negli ultimi 1–2 anni ci siamo trasferiti in un altro luogo di residenza, ho acquisito un nuovo lavoro e infine, grazie al Signore, mi sono per lo più ripreso dagli effetti a lungo termine della Covid. Un ringraziamento speciale a ciascuno di voi che ha pregato per la mia salute.

Mentre mi fermavo in un tranquillo rimpianto, sono rimasto sorpreso da tutte le cose che sono cambiate nei più di 40 anni che posso ricordare. (Anche se ho più di 50 anni, in realtà non ricordo molto dei primissimi anni della mia vita.)

Da ragazzo, giravo su veicoli che non avevano cinture di sicurezza e certamente, nessun airbag. Quando entrambi questi dispositivi “salvavita” furono introdotti, ricordo bene le molte discussioni sul fatto che fossero davvero salvavita nel loro effetto o se l'opposto fosse vero. Tutti i veicoli erano di trazione posteriore o a quattro ruote motrici. Quanto sembrava strano quando cominciarono ad apparire le prime auto a trazione anteriore. Ora abbiamo veicoli ibridi con una spinta verso veicoli completamente elettrici.

Più di quaranta anni fa, la maggior parte dei contadini aveva trattori a benzina con carburatore o trattori diesel con pompa iniettore azionata manualmente. Oggi, la maggior parte dei trattori è equipaggiata con un computer e sembrano chilometri di fili e componenti elettronici vari. Allora, la maggior parte degli agricoltori riusciva a mantenere o riparare i propri mezzi; ora c'è bisogno di macchine diagnostiche e strumenti specializzati che costano molto e richiedono molte ore per imparare a usarli. Questo porta la maggior parte degli agricoltori a fare affidamento sull'esperienza di meccanici specializzati che costano anch'essi molto.

Poi c'è stata la Covid. È stato un periodo stressante. Hai notato cosa è cambiato durante, dopo o a causa della Covid? Nel mio interagire con gli altri, di routine qualcuno dirà che questo o quello è diverso dalla Covid. Sono solo io, o da quando è arrivata la Covid il pubblico in generale è meno amichevole e più riservato nelle proprie interazioni? Controlliamo le nostre interazioni per assicurarci che stiamo ancora essendo la “luce” e il “sale” di Dio in questo mondo oscuro, e che non stiamo perdendo la nostra “salinità”. Inoltre, ci sono cartelli ovunque con la scritta «si cerca personale». Perché? Mi sembra che la Covid abbia incoraggiato ciò che rimaneva dell'etica del lavoro nella nostra società a diminuire ancora di più.

Poi c'è la questione dei telefoni cellulari e delle e-bike. Cosa hanno in comune questi due prodotti non collegati? Dal mio punto di osservazione sugli Amish della contea di Holmes, questi due elementi hanno cambiato un popolo e una cultura in modo più significativo di quasi ogni altra cosa negli ultimi tempi.

Dove ci porta tutto questo? L'autore agli Ebrei dice che Perché essendo mutato il sacerdozio, è di necessità mutata anche la legge – Ebrei 7:12. Quindi, vediamo che Dio ha cambiato le cose come ha ritenuto opportuno; dunque, se dobbiamo cambiare per diventare più biblici, allora dovremmo farlo. Ma l'apostolo Paolo dice Che non siamo più fanciulli, smossi qua e là e portati via da ogni vento di dottrina… – Efesini 4:14.

E perché l'iniquità abbonderà, l'amore della maggior parte si raffredderà. Ma chi avrà perseverato fino alla fine, costui sarà salvato – Matteo 24:12-13. Dunque, vigiliamo in questi ultimi tempi mentre il cambiamento accade sempre di più intorno a noi. Possiamo essere tra coloro che persevereranno fino alla fine.

Sigmund Freud, the “father of psychology” and an enemy of the Christian faith, spent much time reflecting on the “problem” of how to overcome the sense of guilt, which he believed to be the negative by-product of religious teaching. He commented that “only through the solidarity of all the participants (of a group) could the sense of guilt be assuaged.”

Being a member of a group with a common focus or goal has the ability to radically change, not only man’s outlook and views, but also his concept of right and wrong, good and evil, etc. It can indeed rid the soul of its normal God-given sense of guilt as the standards of right and wrong are modified. Some parents have discovered this fact when their young people joined a youth group. Some who previously respected their parents’, the church’s, and God’s authority, no longer held the same convictions. If they joined a group whose focus was to have fun and they believed that the “established” rules, facts, and truth were what stood in the way of fulfilling their carnal desires, then the establishment and their rules became the enemy of the group. Right and wrong are determined by the consensus of the group in respect to its goals. If the goal is pleasure, “It isn’t right for (any authority or any rule) to interfere.”

“The child takes on the characteristic behavior of the group in which he is placed … he reflects the behavior patterns which are set by the … leader of the group” (Kurt Lewin, in A Sociology of Education).

Although it seems strange, “it is usually easier to change individuals formed into a group than to change any one of them separately”, according to Kurt Lewin. An individual will naturally resist change to his or her personal beliefs. However, one who is already a member of a group with a common goal (which all groups have), will automatically have that resistance broken down, as far as attitudes of the group are concerned. Example: I am part of this group, so the outlook and opinions of the group are my outlook and opinions. Too often, not one individual of the group will thoroughly examine the group’s beliefs but will take them for granted because they are a part of the group to which he or she belongs.

“One of the most fascinating aspects of group therapy is that everyone is born again, born together in the group”. (Irvin D. Yalom). This can easily be observed among all ages who are part of a group by virtue of common interests.

Adolf Hitler made very effective use of group dynamics with his Hitler Youth groups. Not only was he able to give them a sense of belonging and a cause to support, but he was able to effectively change the moral compass of the youth of his day.

The Bible also records very effective group dynamics and how quickly they can influence people without evidence. In Acts 14:1, we see the group ready to offer sacrifices to Paul as a god, and in the next verse they stoned him. Acts 19 tells of a group yelling “Great is Diana of the Ephesians” for hours. Verse 32 says that most of the people didn’t even know what the fuss was about, but they would have killed for whatever it was. In these examples, possibly not even one individual really stopped to seriously consider what was morally right or wrong. They were taking up the cause of the group. It gave a sense of “rightness” and belonging, just to be a contributing supporter of the cause. But stop and think—the cause, the action, and the consequences should always be carefully considered.

These people were not taking individual responsibility to determine what is morally right and wrong. Too often people don’t, rather they only function as a group. But the Bible tells us that the time will come when we will all be personally held accountable for what we have done in this life. At that time, what the group believed or did will make no difference. When we (each one of us) will stand one day (at the end of time) before God’s judgement throne, we will be judged according to …the righteous judgment of God; Who will render to every man according to his deeds –Romans 2:5-6.

As we read in the biblical books of the Kings and the Chronicles, Israel, as a nation, functioned with strong group dynamics. When a good king came to power, the nation in general turned to the Lord. When an evil king came to power, the nation in general turned to idol worship. There were a few exceptions—a few people who thought for themselves—whose allegiance to God was greater than their allegiance to the king or nation.

The Christian church itself is a group, influencing and changing the perspectives and morality of individuals for the right or the wrong. Dependent on the convictions of the group and its leaders, the church can be an influence of godly morality, or it can explain away the Bible’s concepts of good and evil.

There should be a major difference between the Christian church and all other groups regarding how their group dynamics work. The Christian church is a group for the express purpose of turning people’s allegiance and faith to Jesus Christ as revealed in His Word, rather than to the group itself. A church whose goal is to gain converts to itself has failed in its mission as detailed in God’s Word. A church that is successful in turning people from all other allegiances to Jesus Christ is a successful church. Allegiance to Jesus includes obedience to His Word which requires obedience to all authorities, including the church. But the Christian’s obedience to the church is secondary and a result of his obedience to Jesus, not the other way around. If a church is successful in turning its members’ faith and focus to Jesus as revealed in His Word, these members will then be unwilling to allow the church to accept unscriptural modern doctrines, and the church will remain sound in …the faith which was once delivered unto the saints –Jude 1:3.

May each one of us, both collectively and individually, focus our faith on Jesus Christ.

Ο Sigmund Freud, ο «πατέρας της ψυχολογίας» και εχθρός της χριστιανικής πίστης, αφιέρωνε πολύ χρόνο στη σκέψη γύρω από το «πρόβλημα» του πώς να ξεπεραστεί το αίσθημα ενοχής, το οποίο πίστευε ότι ήταν το αρνητικό παραπροϊόν της θρησκευτικής διδασκαλίας. Σχολίασε ότι «μόνο μέσω της αλληλεγγύης όλων των συμμετεχόντων (μιας ομάδας) μπορούσε να απαλυνθεί το αίσθημα ενοχής.»

Η συμμετοχή σε μια ομάδα με κοινό προσανατολισμό ή σκοπό έχει την ικανότητα να αλλάξει ριζικά όχι μόνο την οπτική και τις απόψεις του ανθρώπου, αλλά και την αντίληψή του για το σωστό και το λάθος, το καλό και το κακό κ.λπ. Πράγματι μπορεί να απαλλάξει την ψυχή από το φυσιολογικό, δωρεά του Θεού, αίσθημα ενοχής, καθώς τα πρότυπα του σωστού και του λάθους τροποποιούνται. Κάποιοι γονείς ανακάλυψαν αυτό το γεγονός όταν οι νέοι τους εντάχθηκαν σε μια νεανική ομάδα. Άλλοι που προηγουμένως σεβόντουσαν την εξουσία των γονέων τους, της εκκλησίας και του Θεού, δεν διατηρούσαν πλέον τις ίδιες πεποιθήσεις. Εάν εντάχθηκαν σε μια ομάδα που είχε ως στόχο τη διασκέδαση και πίστεψαν ότι οι «εγκατεστημένοι» κανόνες, τα γεγονότα και η αλήθεια στεκόντουσαν εμπόδιο στην εκπλήρωση των σαρκικών τους επιθυμιών, τότε το κατεστημένο και οι κανόνες του έγιναν ο εχθρός της ομάδας. Το σωστό και το λάθος καθορίζονται από την ομοφωνία της ομάδας σε σχέση με τους στόχους της. Αν ο στόχος είναι η απόλαυση, «δεν είναι σωστό (κανένα κύρος ή κανένας κανόνας) να παρεμβαίνει.»

«Το παιδί υιοθετεί τη χαρακτηριστική συμπεριφορά της ομάδας στην οποία τοποθετείται … αντανακλά τα πρότυπα συμπεριφοράς που θέτονται από τον … ηγέτη της ομάδας» (Kurt Lewin, στο A Sociology of Education).

Αν και φαίνεται παράξενο, «συνήθως είναι ευκολότερο να αλλάξεις άτομα σχηματισμένα σε ομάδα παρά να αλλάξεις οποιονδήποτε από αυτά ξεχωριστά», σύμφωνα με τον Kurt Lewin. Ένα άτομο από τη φύση του θα αντισταθεί στην αλλαγή των προσωπικών του πεποιθήσεων. Όμως, κάποιος που ήδη είναι μέλος μιας ομάδας με κοινό στόχο (που έχουν όλες οι ομάδες), θα δει αυτή την αντίσταση να διασπάται αυτόματα, όσον αφορά τις στάσεις της ομάδας. Παράδειγμα: είμαι μέλος αυτής της ομάδας, άρα η οπτική και οι απόψεις της ομάδας είναι η δική μου οπτική και απόψεις. Πολύ συχνά, κανένα άτομο της ομάδας δεν θα εξετάσει διεξοδικά τις πεποιθήσεις της ομάδας, αλλά θα τις θεωρήσει δεδομένες επειδή αποτελεί μέρος της ομάδας στην οποία ανήκει.

«Ένα από τα πιο συναρπαστικά στοιχεία της ομαδικής θεραπείας είναι ότι όλοι γεννιούνται ξανά, γεννιούνται μαζί μέσα στην ομάδα». (Irvin D. Yalom). Αυτό μπορεί εύκολα να παρατηρηθεί σε όλες τις ηλικίες που αποτελούν μέρος μιας ομάδας λόγω κοινών ενδιαφερόντων.

Ο Adolf Hitler έκανε πολύ αποτελεσματική χρήση της δυναμικής των ομάδων με τις ομάδες της Νεολαίας του Χίτλερ. Όχι μόνο μπόρεσε να τους δώσει αίσθημα του ανήκειν και έναν σκοπό να υποστηρίξουν, αλλά μπόρεσε και να αλλάξει αποτελεσματικά την ηθική πυξίδα της νεολαίας της εποχής του.

Η Βίβλος επίσης καταγράφει πολύ αποτελεσματική δυναμική ομάδων και πόσο γρήγορα μπορούν να επηρεάσουν ανθρώπους χωρίς αποδείξεις. Στο Πράξεις 14:1 βλέπουμε την ομάδα έτοιμη να προσφέρει θυσίες στον Παύλο ως θεό, και στον επόμενο στίχο τον λιθοβόλησαν. Η Πράξεις 19 αναφέρει μια ομάδα που φώναζε «Μέγα εστὶ τὴν Διὰνάν τὴν Ἐφέσων» επί ώρες. Ο στίχος 32 λέει ότι οι περισσότεροι από τους ανθρώπους δεν ήξεραν καν για ποιο λόγο η αναστάτωση, αλλά θα είχαν σκοτώσει για οτιδήποτε κι αν ήταν. Σε αυτά τα παραδείγματα, πιθανώς ούτε ένα άτομο δεν σκέφτηκε σοβαρά τι ήταν ηθικά σωστό ή λάθος. Υιοθετούσαν την υπόθεση της ομάδας. Έδινε ένα αίσθημα «ορθότητας» και ανήκειν, απλώς το να είναι κανείς ένας συνεισφέρων υποστηρικτής της υπόθεσης. Αλλά σταματήστε και σκεφτείτε—η υπόθεση, η ενέργεια και οι συνέπειες πρέπει πάντα να εξετάζονται προσεκτικά.

Αυτοί οι άνθρωποι δεν αναλάμβαναν ατομική ευθύνη για να προσδιορίσουν τι είναι ηθικά σωστό και λάθος. Πολύ συχνά οι άνθρωποι δεν το κάνουν, αλλά λειτουργούν μόνο ως ομάδα. Όμως η Βίβλος μας λέει ότι θα έρθει χρόνος όταν όλοι θα κληθούμε να λογοδοτήσουμε προσωπικά για όσα κάναμε σε αυτή τη ζωή. Εκείνη την ημέρα, ό,τι πίστευε ή έκανε η ομάδα δεν θα έχει καμία σημασία. Όταν εμείς (ο καθένας από εμάς) θα σταθούμε μια μέρα (στο τέλος των καιρών) ενώπιον του θρόνου της κρίσεως του Θεού, θα κριθούμε σύμφωνα με …the righteous judgment of God; Who will render to every man according to his deeds –Romans 2:5-6.

Όπως διαβάζουμε στα βιβλία των Βασιλέων και των Χρονικών, το Ισραήλ ως έθνος λειτουργούσε με ισχυρή δυναμική ομάδων. Όταν ανέβαινε στον θρόνο ένας καλός βασιλιάς, το έθνος γενικά στρεφόταν προς τον Κύριο. Όταν ανέβαινε ένας πονηρός βασιλιάς, το έθνος γενικά στρεφόταν στη λατρεία ειδώλων. Υπήρχαν λίγες εξαιρέσεις—λίγα άτομα που σκέφτονταν για τον εαυτό τους—των οποίων η αφοσίωση προς τον Θεό ήταν μεγαλύτερη από την αφοσίωση προς τον βασιλιά ή το έθνος.

Η χριστιανική εκκλησία η ίδια είναι μια ομάδα, που επηρεάζει και αλλάζει τις προοπτικές και την ηθική των ατόμων προς το σωστό ή το λάθος. Ανάλογα με τις πεποιθήσεις της ομάδας και των ηγετών της, η εκκλησία μπορεί να είναι επιρροή θεόπνευστης ηθικής, ή μπορεί να εξηγεί μακριά τις βιβλικές έννοιες του καλού και του κακού.

Πρέπει να υπάρχει μια σημαντική διαφορά μεταξύ της χριστιανικής εκκλησίας και όλων των άλλων ομάδων όσον αφορά τον τρόπο που λειτουργεί η δυναμική τους. Η χριστιανική εκκλησία είναι μια ομάδα με τον ειδικό σκοπό να στρέψει την αφοσίωση και την πίστη των ανθρώπων στον Ιησού Χριστό όπως αποκαλύπτεται στον Λόγο Του, παρά προς την ίδια την ομάδα. Μια εκκλησία που έχει ως στόχο να αποκτήσει οπαδούς για τον εαυτό της έχει αποτύχει στην αποστολή της όπως περιγράφεται στον Λόγο του Θεού. Μια εκκλησία που επιτυγχάνει να στρέψει τους ανθρώπους από κάθε άλλη αφοσίωση προς τον Ιησού Χριστό είναι μια επιτυχημένη εκκλησία. Η αφοσίωση προς τον Ιησού περιλαμβάνει υπακοή στον Λόγο Του που απαιτεί υπακοή σε όλες τις εξουσίες, συμπεριλαμβανομένης της εκκλησίας. Αλλά η υπακοή του χριστιανού στην εκκλησία είναι δευτερεύουσα και αποτέλεσμα της υπακοής του στον Ιησού, όχι το αντίστροφο. Εάν μια εκκλησία έχει επιτυχία στο να στρέψει την πίστη και την προσοχή των μελών της προς τον Ιησού όπως αποκαλύπτεται στον Λόγο Του, τότε αυτά τα μέλη δε θα επιτρέψουν στην εκκλησία να αποδεχθεί ασκηρές σύγχρονες διδασκαλίες, και η εκκλησία θα παραμείνει υγιής στο …the faith which was once delivered unto the saints –Jude 1:3.

Είθε ο καθένας από εμάς, συλλογικά και ατομικά, να εστιάσει την πίστη του στον Ιησού Χριστό.
